newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KBB COMPLETES SARMA STORES BUY.
newsitem.headline: KBB COMPLETES SARMA STORES BUY.

text.p: Dutch department stores group Koninklijke Bijenkorf Beheer NV (KBB) said on Friday it agreed with Belgian GIB Group to take over 16 outlets of Belgian department store chain Sarma.
Additionally, two new outlets offering former Sarma staff a job will be opened and five Sarma outlets will work under a franchising agreement with KBB's HEMA unit, KBB said.
KBB estimated the investments related to the Sarma deal of at around 25 million guilders.
KBB said it did not expect the newly-acquired outlets to contribute to group earnings in 1997, but added it foresaw an increasingly positive impact in later years.
On January 21, KBB announced its HEMA division intended to take over the Belgian chain.
